overview.description: The Kurv U.S. Large Cap TaxOptimized ETF (LCTO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, using derivatives to gain exposure to US large-cap equities while investing the remaining assets in global fixed-income securities. The fund seeks total return and, as a secondary objective, seeks to maximize risk-adjusted after-tax current income LCTO was launched on Jul 6, 2026 and is issued by Kurv.
